description: Vehicle Energy Consumption in Python (venco.py) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by German Aerospace Center (DLR). A data processing tool offering hourly demand and flexibility profiles for future electric vehicle fleets in an aggregated manner. Coverage: Denmark, France, United Kingdom, Netherlands. Methodical focus: Data model, Car mobility, Technical load shifting potential. Time resolution: hour, 15 min. Spatial resolution: national states, federal states. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD 3-clause 'New' or 'Revised' license. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
